fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are a near-verbatim spread of the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide WordPress RSS feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek (article-mode from JSON-LD, or the RSS item description in latest-mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, present on every sampled article's JSON-LD NewsArticle node.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keyword/tag string, as emitted upstream (article-mode only).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Publish date, format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS +05:30' (IST, space-separated -- not standard ISO 8601 T-separated, passed through as upstream emits it).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Last-modified date, same non-standard space-separated IST format as datePublished.

dateCreated.title: Date created
dateCreated.description: Creation date, same non-standard space-separated IST format as datePublished.

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image URL (also duplicated inside the `image` object).

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough -- Person with name+url, e.g. a named byline or a wire-service credit like PTI/ANI).

url.title: Canonical URL
url.description: Canonical article URL as emitted in JSON-LD.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: RSS dc:creator byline, e.g. 'PTI', 'ANI', or 'Telangana Today' for staff-written pieces (latest-mode).

contentEncoded.title: Content (encoded)
contentEncoded.description: Full article HTML (lead image + paragraphs) from the RSS item's content:encoded element (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
